header.title: CPO mass production shifts value to integrated optical-electrical test platform suppliers

s01_bottom_line.text: TrendForce says growing AI data center high-speed transmission demand is accelerating CPO toward mass production, raising demand for integrated optical-electrical test equipment and software, with 2027 pivotal and 2028 critical for large-scale production readiness. ⟨cited figures: forecast⟩
TrendForce expects suppliers that integrate test equipment and provide production-scale services to strengthen their strategic positions as customers emphasize testing efficiency, quality and cost.

Suppliers able to integrate electrical and optical test on a single platform (ATE leaders, Taiwanese modules/interfaces, OSAT) could gain CPO testing share, but the article gives no revenue, margin or earnings quantification.

items.text: Teradyne acquired Quantifi Photonics in 2025 to strengthen optical measurement capabilities.
In September 2026 Advantest announced a collaboration with VIAVI and SENKO combining automated testing, optical measurement and detachable optical interfaces.
The partners demonstrated a simulated production testing workflow for CPO modules at ECOC 2026.
TrendForce expects 2027 to be a pivotal year for convergence of CPO testing architectures. ⟨cited figures: forecast⟩
A complete test of a single PIC can still take over 100 seconds.
TrendForce expects 2028 to be a critical period for validating readiness for large-scale CPO mass production. ⟨cited figures: forecast⟩
